map.选择物探方法并输入装置参数，估算探测深度与垂直分辨率，评估不同工作装置对地下目标: Choose a geophysical method and enter array parameters to estimate depth of investigation and vertical resolution, assessing how well different arrays detect subsurface targets — used for survey design, line layout and feasibility analysis of exploration depth.
map.选择物探方法，输入装置参数估算探测深度与垂直分辨率: Choose a geophysical method and enter array parameters to estimate depth of investigation and vertical resolution
map.电法装置设计：由供电极距 AB 估探测深度与垂直分辨率: Electrical array design: estimate depth of investigation and vertical resolution from the current electrode spacing AB
map.磁法反演：由异常半宽按 Peters 法估磁性体埋深: Magnetic inversion: estimate magnetic body depth from the anomaly half-width using the Peters method
map.地震分辨率：由波速、主频、走时估反射深度与垂向分辨率: Seismic resolution: estimate reflection depth and vertical resolution from velocity, dominant frequency and travel time
map.：算法（三法可选）：电法探测深度≈AB/2、垂直分辨率≈电极距 a、深径比=深度: : Algorithm (three methods): electrical depth of investigation ≈ AB/2, vertical resolution ≈ electrode spacing a, depth-resolution ratio = depth/a; magnetic (Peters) depth h ≈ half-width hw/1.31, resolution ≈ h/4, total anomaly width = 2·hw; seismic reflection depth H=v·t/2, wavelength λ=v/f, vertical resolution ≈ λ/4. Used for scheme feasibility and survey line layout.
map.：例（电法）：AB=200m、a=20m → 探测深度≈100.00m、分辨率≈: : Example (electrical): AB=200m, a=20m → depth of investigation ≈ 100.00 m, resolution ≈ 20.00 m, depth-resolution ratio 5.00 (a larger ratio favours resolving thin deep layers). Example (magnetic): anomaly half-width hw=40m → depth h ≈ 40/1.31 = 30.53 m, resolution ≈ 7.63 m, total anomaly width 80.00 m, indicating a shallow magnetic body.
map.探测深度和分辨率能同时提高吗？: Can depth of investigation and resolution be improved together?
map.通常相互制约：加大极距/偏移距增深但分辨率下降。电法深径比（深度/分辨率）是折中: They usually trade off: a larger electrode/offset spacing increases depth but lowers resolution. The depth-resolution ratio (depth/resolution) is the compromise metric; back out the required spacing from the target body scale instead of chasing depth.
map.Peters 法埋深准吗？: Is the Peters method accurate for burial depth?
map.Peters 法假设板状磁性体且异常近似对称，对简单孤立磁源较适用；倾斜产状或叠: The Peters method assumes a plate-shaped magnetic body with a near-symmetric anomaly, so it suits simple isolated sources; inclined geometry or superposed anomalies distort the half-width, and results should be used with profile shape and inversion as a preliminary estimate.
